labels.name: task_done
labels.description: Mark a task as complete, or several at once with `tasks` (max 50). They move to the Logbook view. A set of 50 is undone one task_reopen call at a time, so confirm the list with the user first.

labels.name: task_reopen
labels.description: Reopen a completed task, or several at once with `tasks` (max 50). Each returns to its previous view.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: guide, task_list, task_show, task_add, comment, attachment · Private data: task_show, attachment · Public sink: attachment · Destructive: task_add, task_edit, checklist, comment, attachment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: guide, task_list, task_show, task_add, comment, attachment · Private data: task_show, attachment · Public sink: attachment · Destructive: task_add, task_edit, checklist, comment, attachment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
